# ascent-support

Public support, privacy and terms pages for **Ascent**, the word ladder puzzle
for iPhone and iPad, served by GitHub Pages at <https://williamscott701.github.io/ascent-support/>.

| Page | URL |
|---|---|
| Support and FAQ | <https://williamscott701.github.io/ascent-support/> |
| Privacy policy | <https://williamscott701.github.io/ascent-support/privacy.html> |
| Terms of use | <https://williamscott701.github.io/ascent-support/terms.html> |

App Review and the App Store listing link to these pages, so they must stay
reachable without an account.

**Do not edit the HTML by hand.** Every page is generated by
`scripts/make-support-site.py` in the Ascent app repository; change the
generator, run it, and commit the output here. Earlier wording of the privacy
policy and terms stays available in this repository's history.

Contact: William Scott, <williamscott701@gmail.com>
